page_title: LIV 3-0 BOU | Liverpool v Bournemouth 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
87' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
85' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
84' Booking. Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) receives a caution from the referee.
83' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
83' The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.

83' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Enes Unal (Bournemouth), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
81' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
76' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
76' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) replaces Evanilson.
73' Arne Slot prepares a substitution. Darwin Nunez is replaced by Federico Chiesa (Liverpool).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Luis Diaz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Substitution. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) on for Antoine Semenyo.
70' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Smith (Bournemouth) replacing Julian Araujo.
69' That will be all from Ryan Christie who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
69' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 9:3.
64' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner but it's cleared.
64' Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
61' Substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) in, Dominik Szoboszlai out.
58' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.

56' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but Kepa Arrizabalaga is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
54' Surely that's handball by one of the Bournemouth players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
54' Ball possession – 59:41.
53' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
50' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner with a short pass.
49' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Half-time substitution. Andoni Iraola decided to make a change. Justin Kluivert is replaced by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Tony Harrington has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Neat passing move from Bournemouth in order to create new attacking opportunities.
43' The Liverpool players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

40' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Kepa Arrizabalaga is alert and denies him with a nice save.
37' 3 - 0 After receiving a beautiful pass, Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) had a huge opportunity. He coolly unleashed a perfect shot, which went in off the left post.
33' Great teamplay by Bournemouth as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
32' Shots on target – 6:2.
29' 2 - 0 Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low in the middle of the goal.

27' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
26' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Andoni Iraola (Bournemouth) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
24' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
22' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
20' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
18' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
15' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Kepa Arrizabalaga.
14' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
5' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bournemouth due to an offside in the build-up play.
5' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) collects a sweet pass inside the penalty box and smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish!
2' The resulting set piece from Liverpool is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
2' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Bournemouth will take the kick-off.
Tony Harrington will referee today's match.
